purpose: Provide the canonical substantive review record for Attribute identities required by the current Character creation slice.
Review the nine Attribute identity names, normalized keys, category bindings, deterministic ordering, and creation-rule references.
Bind source-backed findings to checklist checks, evidence records, formal identity decisions, affected artifacts, fixtures, and tests.
Prevent structural catalog presence from being treated as substantive Attribute approval.

consistencyRules.requirement: all nine required Attribute identities appear exactly once
Physical, Social, and Mental each contain exactly three required Attribute identities
every required Attribute has one unique deterministic order value
every Attribute review check key is unique
every finding references one required Attribute identity
every final source-backed finding references current source evidence
review completion requires active final decisions for all nine Attribute identities
reviewStatus counts reconcile with identities, checks, findings, evidence, issues, and decisions
catalog presence, fixtures, or candidate source claims do not imply approval

prototypeNotes: This artifact defines the Attribute review record and contains no fabricated findings or approvals.
The nine expected identities and three category groupings are candidate source claims until evidence references are recorded.
Deterministic order is a package contract concern and must remain stable even when localized display text changes.
Attribute identity review does not approve allocation mechanics such as 7/5/3, starting rating, maximum rating, or freebie costs.
Chronicle owns contract validation, evidence integrity, staleness detection, diagnostics, fingerprints, task-status integration, and promotion enforcement.
Assigned Rule Set reviewers own substantive source-backed findings and final Attribute identity recommendations.

sourceEvidence.paraphrase: The cleaned extraction enumerates the nine Attributes and groups them into Physical, Social, and Mental categories.
Attributes start at 1, use distinct Primary/Secondary/Tertiary priorities, and allocate 7/5/3 additional points.
No Attribute exceeds 5 during Character creation base allocation.
Attributes are handled through prioritize-attributes and allocate-attributes steps in the staged creation workflow.

sourceEvidence.sourceLocator: CF-003 Character Creation Is a Workflow
sourceEvidence.paraphrase: Base allocations are prerequisite workflow steps before later phases and must remain deterministic.
